description: The pie chart illustrates the character distribution in RoleplayPref, which is organized into 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories. The largest segment, representing "Virtual Characters," is further divided into subcategories including "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," each shown in varying shades of light blue. The "Real Characters" category, depicted in green, includes subcategories such as "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," with each subcategory represented by a distinct shade of green. The "Custom Characters" category, shown in red, is a single subcategory. The chart visually emphasizes the proportion of each category and subcategory through the size of the slices, with the "Virtual Characters" segment being the largest, followed by "Real Characters," and then "Custom Characters."
